Remember when employee appreciation was just a pizza party?

Now it has AI.

In this video, we take a look at AI-powered employee appreciation platforms that promise to turn every thank you, recognition message, and reward into "leadership intelligence."

Because apparently appreciation isn't enough anymore.

Now it needs dashboards.
Analytics.
Retention scores.
Engagement metrics.
And AI mining employee data for "insights."
